protocol.hypothesis: An observable ZigZag leg length reaching 100% or 150% of the preceding leg, followed by one to three bars without a new extreme, may improve reversal entry timing across 1H, 4H, 1D and 1W.

research_provenance.source: User supplied Trendoscope Band-Zigzag Pine plus chart 2026-11-08
research_provenance.note: Source label first percentage is |current pivot - prior pivot| / |prior pivot - pivot before|. Second percentage is normalized location outside adaptive band, not a 100% return target and is at least 100% at a band touch. Imported sticky/adaptive band internals are not reproduced here.

protocol.parameter_rationale: Compare no leg-length gate against 100% and 150%; wait 1, 2, 3 completed bars without a new band extreme; require reverse candle close or prior-bar extreme break. Band length20/multiplier2 and exit on opposite entry fixed to isolate entry timing.
protocol.baseline: 25%-capital buy-and-hold control on each same-stock timeframe; r0/s1/close is the unfiltered first-pause control.
protocol.signal_rule: Completed bars compute SMA20(close) ± 2 population standard deviations. High/low band touch creates or replaces the latest provisional ZigZag extreme; a candle touching both is ignored. Its first label percentage is the current leg price length divided by the preceding leg length; the second label percentB is not used because a band touch itself makes it >=100%. After the chosen exact number of completed bars without a new extreme, if the leg-ratio threshold is met and the candle reverses or breaks the previous bar extreme, create one signal per pivot. Long follows a low, short follows a high. Fill at next bar open; exit only by an opposite signal, also at next open. No future pivot confirmation or backdating.
protocol.signal_semantics: Causal post-band-extreme stall; threshold refers to ZigZag leg-length ratio, not price return.
protocol.evaluation_unit: Independent 1m RUB virtual account per symbol; this is not a combined portfolio.
protocol.execution_timing: Observe a completed signal candle on the declared timeframe; enter at the next available bar open.
protocol.holding_period: Until opposite entry signal; no fixed profit target or stop in this entry-timing comparison.
protocol.rebalance_rule: No intrabar rebalance; at most one position per account.
protocol.availability_lag: Current bar close; a provisional pivot can be revised only by information available at later closes.
protocol.cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
protocol.selection: Compare predeclared 18 variants and the buy-and-hold control across all available symbols and timeframes. Report each full calendar month and latest complete 12 months. Do not promote from this research until source-band and Pine/Python signal parity, corporate events and independent holdout are verified.

untested_dependencies: Alternative fixed target and stop exits

limitations: The source script label percentage is a leg-length ratio, not a return percentage
A provisional pivot may be replaced; historical line appearance is not the real-time signal time
The Band-ZigZag implementation uses explicit non-sticky Bollinger bands rather than the imported source library
Corporate actions and short borrowing incomplete

validation.note: DATA_READY confirms data and report gates only; it does not approve a trading strategy.

candle_quality.note: Intraday gaps are heuristic; a quiet instrument or session break can be legitimate.
